stem: A wheel of radius R meter rolls forward half a revolution on a horizontal ground. The magnitude of the displacement of the point of the wheel initially in contact with the ground is?

assets.alt: A wheel rolling to the right. The start position (dashed circle, centre C) has point P at the bottom; the end position (solid circle, centre C′) is πR further on, with P at the top. A dashed blue arc shows P's curved path; a red arrow Δr joins P (start) to P (end), spanning πR horizontally and 2R vertically.
